label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verse: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
note: 'Study' here means 'be diligent' — though the reading habit doesn't hurt either.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jesus said unto them, I am the _____ of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
verse: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
note: Bread of life: the staple, not the dessert — Jesus claims the daily necessities.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did _____.
verse: And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did swim.
note: A borrowed axe head lost in the river, and Elisha makes iron swim — small problems matter to God too.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly _____ for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
verse: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
note: Jude planned a pleasant letter and wrote a battle summons instead — the faith was worth the fight.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my _____, I have kept the faith:
verse: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
note: Paul finished his 'course' — the race-lane. Modern versions say 'race'; the KJV keeps the track.
